meta.name: claw-x-hub
meta.description:
Cloud file hosting, static site deployment, and cloud compilation using x hub.
Use when the agent needs to share files/images, deploy a static website, or perform cloud compilation.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 在云端托管文件、部署静态网站并执行编译任务
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要快速在云端托管文件或部署静态网站
copy.tagline_en: Host files, deploy static sites, and compile in the cloud
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to quickly host files or deploy static websites in the cloud

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 可以上传文件到云端、生成分享链接、部署静态网站，以及执行云端编译。
howto.when: 当 Claude 需要分享文件或图片、部署静态网站，或进行云端编译时触发。

say.text: 帮我上传这个文件到云端。
say.note: Claude 会执行文件上传命令。

say.text: 生成这个文件的分享链接。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can upload files to the cloud, generate share links, deploy static websites, and perform cloud compilation.
howto.when_en: Triggered when Claude needs to share files/images, deploy a static website, or perform cloud compilation.

say_en.text: Upload this file to the cloud.
say_en.note: Claude will execute the file upload command.

say_en.text: Generate a share link for this file.
say_en.note: Claude will get the share link.
